newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: BIS offers membership to nine central banks.
newsitem.headline: BIS offers membership to nine central banks.

text.p: The Bank for International Settlements (BIS), central bank to the world's central banks, on Monday said its board of directors would invite nine central banks to become members of the BIS by subscribing to BIS shares.

Wim Duisenberg, BIS chairman and chairman of the Dutch central bank, told a news conference the invited central banks were Hong Kong Monetary Authority, The People's Bank of China, Banco Central do Brasil, Reserve Bank of India, Bank of Korea, Banco de Mexico, Central Bank of the Russian Federation, Saudia Arabian Monetary Agency and the Monetary Authority of Singapore.
